SHARED-F-2-S10.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement
SHARED-F-2-S10.description: Implement domain logic for two-tier HIPAA consent including Tier 1 (basic interaction) and Tier 2 (identified data storage). Enforce rules for when data can be stored, trigger de-identification when Tier 2 is not granted, and handle consent upgrades.

SHARED-F-2-S11.title: Consent Workflow Integration with Lead Capture and Unknowns
SHARED-F-2-S11.description: Integrate consent framework with lead_capture and unknown_question_service to ensure consent gating is enforced before storing identifiable data and that de-identification is applied consistently across flows.

SHARED-F-2-S12.title: Consent Framework Tests (Unit + Integration)
SHARED-F-2-S12.description: Create unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, de-identification behavior, API enforcement, and integration with dependent services. Cover edge cases including missing consent, partial upgrades, and error handling.
